description: Light twin with wingtip tanks standing on a walled and planted plot fronting Avenue de la Révolution in central Ouagadougou, roughly 1.9 km south-west of the air base and adjacent to the ASECNA-DGAC grounds. The airframe record gives Ce.310 while the same source's location description says Ce.402; the two cannot be reconciled and the source flags the type as unconfirmed. It carries no readable registration, so tail_number is blank. Clearly visible on Google 0.3 m imagery and on Esri WorldView-3 imagery acquired 10 December 2025.
museum_name: Avion de l'Avenue de la Révolution
